terms.quote: P046 cond 1 (binding council text): Every provider (VPNDetection, IPQuery, IPLocate, InternetData, ipapi.is, proxycheck.io) is terms 'unknown' and tier unknown until legal reviews it: disabled in every profile until legal records its terms (A1).

api.notes: Research C0114 (verified_live 200). The answer is keyed by the IP as sent; errors come inside HTTP 200 bodies ({'status': 'error'|'denied', 'message': ...}): error markers below. Keyless: a small daily allowance (100/day per the vendor's pricing page, not re-verified). Used by ip_anonymizer_consensus.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P046). ipapi.is (api.ipapi.is) is not wired: keyless answers carry no detection flags and P046 cond 4 caps the wired providers at 4 (see docs/backlog/p2-G02-2.md).
